name: ascn-smart-cities-network
description: ASCN V2 Progress Observatory: a lightweight analytics workbench for ASEAN Smart Cities Network reports, city projects, and evidence.

scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/security.unit.mjs tests/news.unit.mjs tests/ascn-review.unit.mjs tests/correspondence.unit.mjs tests/archive.unit.mjs
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run vendor:leaflet && npm run vendor:fonts && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --compatibility-date=2026-06-20
scripts.deploy: npm run check && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name ascn-smart-cities-network --branch main
scripts.predeploy: node scripts/refresh-ascn-news.mjs || echo "news refresh failed, shipping the existing snapshot"
